==Acquisition ==
This skill is available whenever your character is riding a [[Junundu]], from the [[Gate of Desolation]] [[mission]] onward through the rest of the [[Desolation]].

==Notes==
*The user is counted. Dead [[pet]]s and [[hero]]es ''not'' in Junundu form are not counted. [[Junundu Young]] are not counted.
*Junundu are resurrected at full health and [[energy]].
